title: H27 Payne tuple extractor
coordinate_model: non-neighbours of anchor are (a,b,d) from projective vector (a,b,1,d) over F3

raw_local_27_shell.interpretation: raw affine H27 shell / AG(3,3) bulk; not yet Schlaefli or GQ(2,4)

conclusion: The H27/SRG connection is real after the index correction: the raw 27 non-neighbour shell is 8-regular, but Payne derivation by adjoining the 9 Heisenberg vertical fibres turns it into GQ(2,4)=SRG(27,10,1,5); its complement is the Schlaefli graph SRG(27,16,10,8). This is a transformed local shell, not the raw dual of W(3,3) collinearity.
